snippet.title: MISFORTUNA ITCH DEMO TRAILER
snippet.description:
This is the very first trailer for our game "Misfortuna", We would love your feedback! And maybe even a wishlist on Steam, it would help our tiny studio a ton! 

Itch web demo: https://bithydrastudio.itch.io/misfortuna
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5082120?utm_source=Youtube

NO GENERATIVE AI HAS BEEN USED IN CREATING THIS GAME! 
We enjoy doing the work, so we will never implement AI assets in our game!

Misfortuna is a satisfying incremental roulette game. Spin a roulette wheel, stack absurd upgrades, multiply your balls, and watch payouts spiral from pocket change to numbers that barely fit on the screen!

Thank you!
